# More Cultural Names
# Generated by the More Cultural Names Builder

more_cultural_names_evaluate_and_assign_state_hub_dynamic_names = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_game_rule = no_dynamic_naming }
        reset_state_name = yes
        reset_hub_names = yes
    }
    else = {
        more_cultural_names_assign_state_hub_dynamic_names = yes
    }
}

more_cultural_names_assign_state_hub_dynamic_names = {
    if = {
        limit = { state_region = { s:STATE_ALPHA ?= this } }
        more_cultural_names_STATE_ALPHA_state_name_assign = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { state_region = { s:STATE_BETA ?= this } }
        more_cultural_names_STATE_BETA_state_name_assign = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { state_region = { s:STATE_GAMMA ?= this } }
        more_cultural_names_STATE_GAMMA_state_name_assign = yes
    }
}

more_cultural_names_STATE_ALPHA_state_name_assign = {
    if = {
        limit = { owner = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:english } }
        set_state_name = STATE_ALPHA_english
    }
    if = {
        limit = { owner = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:french } }
        set_state_name = STATE_ALPHA_french
    }
    if = {
        limit = { owner = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:romanian } }
        set_state_name = STATE_ALPHA_romanian
    }
}

more_cultural_names_STATE_BETA_state_name_assign = {
    if = {
        limit = { owner = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:english } }
        set_state_name = STATE_BETA_english
    }
    if = {
        limit = { owner = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:french } }
        set_state_name = STATE_BETA_french
    }
    if = {
        limit = { owner = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:romanian } }
        set_state_name = STATE_BETA_romanian
    }
}

more_cultural_names_STATE_GAMMA_state_name_assign = {
    if = {
        limit = { owner = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:english } }
        set_state_name = STATE_GAMMA_english
    }
    if = {
        limit = { owner = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:french } }
        set_state_name = STATE_GAMMA_french
    }
    if = {
        limit = { owner = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:romanian } }
        set_state_name = STATE_GAMMA_romanian
    }
}
